UnitStatement: The decomposition-package-review skill is used with a generic TASK shell and no task profile.
A decomposition-package-review brief reviews the active DOMAIN decomposition package after a scope change.
A decomposition-package-review task uses TaskSkill value decomposition-package-review.
AllowedWriteTargets must contain report paths and any explicitly authorized package-local repair targets.
ScopePath is the absolute path to one DOMAIN root and normally equals ROOT_PATH.
ROOT_PATH is the absolute path to the root under review.
DECOMPOSITION_ROOT is a required absolute path to _Decomposition.
SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT is a required absolute path to _ScopeChange.
REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH must be inside AllowedWriteTargets.
MODE must be either REVIEW_ONLY or REVIEW_AND_REPAIR.
FINDINGS_CSV_PATH is an optional absolute path for a structured findings log.
PARITY_MATRIX_PATH is an optional absolute path for a parity matrix.
ACTIVE_SNAPSHOT_PATH overrides _LATEST.md when _LATEST.md should not decide.
MAX_FINDINGS is a positive integer with default 80.
Decomposition-package-review uses TaskProfile NONE in generic TASK shell mode.
The skill reads only DECOMPOSITION_ROOT, SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT/_LATEST.md, and the active _ScopeChange/SCA-* snapshot.
The brief must not authorize KTY-local, hypergraph, audit, or publication reads.
The skill always writes REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH.
The skill may write FINDINGS_CSV_PATH and PARITY_MATRIX_PATH when those optional paths are provided.
In REVIEW_AND_REPAIR mode, the brief may additionally authorize explicit package-local repair targets under _Decomposition or _ScopeChange.
A typical task verifies that a DOMAIN root's active decomposition package is internally consistent after SCOPE_CHANGE.
A typical task verifies active snapshot completeness and _LATEST.md parity.
A typical task separates package-local repair work from downstream reruns.
A typical task produces root-level closure evidence before Phase 7 or publication gating.
One invocation reviews one DOMAIN root only.
REVIEW_ONLY is the safe default for decomposition-package-review.
KTY-local metadata drift should be handled with kty-metadata-align, not by widening decomposition-package-review.
A valid run requires ROOT_PATH, DECOMPOSITION_ROOT, and SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT to exist.
A valid run requires the active snapshot to be resolved from _LATEST.md or explicitly provided.
The review report must state READY, READY_WITH_GAPS, or BLOCKED.
Findings must distinguish DECOMP_LOCAL_REPAIR, SNAPSHOT_REPAIR, DOWNSTREAM_RERUN, and HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED.
Every blocking or material-warning finding must cite a local surface path.
REVIEW_ONLY runs modify no package-local truth.
REVIEW_AND_REPAIR runs modify only explicitly authorized files under _Decomposition or _ScopeChange.
Active snapshot resolution failure or ambiguity is a blocking condition that must surface.
Material disagreement between duplicated package-local truth surfaces is a blocking condition that must surface.
An incomplete active snapshot is a blocking condition that must surface.
Unsupported phase claims in RUN_SUMMARY.md or Handoff_State.md are blocking conditions that must surface.
A write target outside authorized package-local paths is a blocking condition that must surface.
If FINDINGS_CSV_PATH is provided, each finding row includes Severity, FindingClass, SurfacePath, and Summary.
If PARITY_MATRIX_PATH is provided, each parity row includes SurfacePath, ParityStatus, and RequiredAction.
A clean run reports the reviewed root.
A clean run reports the active snapshot path.
A clean run reports the package verdict.
A clean run reports whether any repairs were applied.
A clean run reports whether downstream reruns remain.
A clean run explicitly says when no material issues remain.
Decomposition-package-review reviews one bounded DOMAIN root as a closed decomposition package.
The closed decomposition package consists of _Decomposition, _ScopeChange/_LATEST.md, and the active _ScopeChange/SCA-* snapshot.
The skill checks whether duplicated decomposition-local truth surfaces agree.
The skill checks whether the active snapshot satisfies the current SCOPE_CHANGE contract.
The skill checks whether the recorded handoff state matches the actual package state.
REVIEW_ONLY mode inspects and reports only.
REVIEW_AND_REPAIR mode performs only bounded decomposition-local repairs that are explicitly authorized and mechanically derivable from authoritative package truth.
The skill never repairs KTY-local content.
The skill never repairs hypergraph outputs, audit outputs, or publication artifacts.
The skill is suitable for TASK in generic shell mode with no profile.
SCOPE_CHANGE closeout can dispatch decomposition-package-review.
Root remediation closure steps can dispatch decomposition-package-review.
Follow-on review loops before Phase 7 or publication gating can dispatch decomposition-package-review.
AllowedWriteTargets is an explicit list of report paths and repair-authorized decomposition-local files for the run.
ACTIVE_SNAPSHOT_PATH is optional and autodetects from _LATEST.md when omitted.
MAX_FINDINGS is optional and defaults to 80.
The SKILL read boundary is limited to DECOMPOSITION_ROOT, SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT/_LATEST.md, and the active snapshot under SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT.
The skill must not widen reads to KTY-local folders, _Aggregation, _Reconciliation, hypergraph outputs, or publication outputs.
Writes are limited to REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH, optional findings CSV, optional parity matrix, and repair-mode authorized files under DECOMPOSITION_ROOT or SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT.
The skill must never write KTY-local folders, _Aggregation, _Reconciliation, hypergraph outputs, or publication outputs.
Decomposition-package-review is reasoning-first only.
The skill has no allowed-tools frontmatter.
The skill must not be used for cross-root conformity review.
KTY-local metadata repair belongs to kty-metadata-align rather than decomposition-package-review.
Ambiguous truth conflicts must not be silently repaired.
Missing snapshot artifacts, missing decomposition rows, and unsupported phase-completion claims must not be invented.
Step 0 validates ROOT_PATH, DECOMPOSITION_ROOT, and SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT.
Step 0 resolves ACTIVE_SNAPSHOT_PATH when provided, otherwise reads _LATEST.md.
Step 0 reports missing, empty, or ambiguous _LATEST.md resolution.
Step 0 validates REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH is inside AllowedWriteTargets.
In REVIEW_AND_REPAIR mode, Step 0 validates every non-report write target is inside _Decomposition or _ScopeChange.
Step 1 inventories the main decomposition markdown.
Step 1 inventories decomposition-local derivatives and annexes under _Decomposition.
Step 1 inventories _ScopeChange/_LATEST.md and active snapshot artifacts.
Step 1 treats the package as a closed system.
Local derivative surfaces carrying duplicated counts, mappings, status, open-issue state, validation evidence, or handoff state are in scope for comparison.
Step 2 classifies every major surface by package role before building the parity matrix.
A working surface is the main decomposition document and primary human-facing control surface.
An authoritative companion register is a companion file holding heavy machine-truth as the primary working surface for that data.
A snapshot / handoff artifact is an immutable amendment snapshot or handoff-state record.
A derived publication artifact is a render, bundle, or review document assembled from the modular package and is not the amendment surface.
For each reviewed surface, Step 2 records the assigned package-role label.
For each reviewed surface, Step 2 records whether the main decomposition document is overly monolithic relative to companion truth.
For each reviewed surface, Step 2 records whether a companion register should be promoted or demoted.
For each reviewed surface, Step 2 records whether any artifact is ambiguously labeled or unlabeled.
Step 3 compares authoritative surfaces for top-level telemetry and counts.
Step 3 compares category, knowledge-type, and subject parity.
Step 3 compares objective support parity, open-issue parity, mapping-table parity, and validation-check parity.
Step 3 compares active snapshot artifact completeness and handoff-state consistency.
Step 3 classifies package state as MATCH, DRIFT, MISSING, or NOT_APPLICABLE.
Every finding must land in exactly one finding class.
Stale duplicated annex rows are classified as DECOMP_LOCAL_REPAIR.
Wrong _LATEST.md or incomplete active snapshot findings are classified as SNAPSHOT_REPAIR.
KTY-local content drift implied by package truth is classified as DOWNSTREAM_RERUN.
Contradictory authoritative package surfaces with no clear winner are classified as HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED.
Step 5 runs only when MODE is REVIEW_AND_REPAIR.
Step 5 repairs only files explicitly authorized by AllowedWriteTargets.
Step 5 repairs only when the fix is mechanically derivable from already accepted package truth.
Step 5 allows duplicated decomposition-local derivative parity repairs.
Step 5 allows active snapshot pointer parity repairs.
Step 5 allows repairs to stale handoff-state or run-summary state fields relative to accepted artifact state.
Step 5 disallows substantive decomposition truth changes requiring human judgment.
Step 5 disallows inventing missing snapshot artifacts.
Step 5 disallows KTY-local metadata or content repair.
The review report title must identify Decomposition Package Review for the root name.
The review report metadata block includes root path, active snapshot, mode, and review date.
The review report states package verdict READY, READY_WITH_GAPS, or BLOCKED.
The review report includes package-role classification for each reviewed surface.
The review report includes a parity summary.
The review report groups findings by the four required classes.
The review report lists repairs applied in the run when repairs exist.
The review report lists required downstream reruns when they exist.
The review report includes explicit RUN_STATUS.
Decomposition-local drift repair classes DECOMP_LOCAL_REPAIR and SNAPSHOT_REPAIR are authoritative work that the skill may fix directly in REVIEW_AND_REPAIR mode.
Observations about derived publication artifacts are for reporting only and must not be repaired by this skill.
A parity matrix, when provided, includes SurfacePath, SurfaceType, ComparisonBasis, ParityStatus, AuthorityBasis, and RequiredAction.
A findings CSV, when provided, includes FindingID, Severity, FindingClass, SurfacePath, Summary, AuthorityBasis, and RecommendedAction.
The skill outputs Decomposition_Package_Review.md at REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH.
The skill may output a findings CSV at FINDINGS_CSV_PATH.
The skill may output a parity matrix at PARITY_MATRIX_PATH.
The skill reviews exactly one DOMAIN root per run.
The skill treats _Decomposition plus the active _ScopeChange snapshot as the full scope.
The skill escalates authoritative surface disagreement when no clear authority basis exists.
Repair is opt-in and limited to explicitly approved mechanically derivable package-local drift.
Every material finding cites a local surface.
The reviewed root and active snapshot must be explicit.
The report must state READY, READY_WITH_GAPS, or BLOCKED.
Findings must distinguish decomposition-local repair, snapshot repair, downstream rerun, and human-decision classes.
REVIEW_AND_REPAIR runs list every repaired file explicitly.
The preferred workflow reads _Decomposition before resolving the active _ScopeChange snapshot from _LATEST.md.
The preferred workflow enumerates package-local derivative surfaces before building the parity matrix.
In REVIEW_AND_REPAIR mode, the preferred workflow applies only explicitly authorized, mechanically derivable package-local repairs.
The preferred workflow writes the report and optional structured outputs after review and any authorized repairs.
No TASK-enforced deterministic tools are declared for decomposition-package-review.
No operational deterministic helpers are declared for decomposition-package-review.
Reasoning determines which local surfaces count as duplicated package truth.
Reasoning determines whether a finding belongs to package repair, snapshot repair, rerun, or human escalation.
Reasoning determines whether a repair is genuinely mechanical and authorized.
Reasoning determines whether handoff-state claims are supported by package evidence.
The skill performs no KTY-local reads or writes outside brief-authorized package review artifacts.
The tool policy forbids using decomposition-package-review as a substitute for cross-root conformity review.
The tool policy forbids repairs to hypergraph, audit, or publication outputs.
The tool policy forbids silent synthesis of missing snapshot artifacts.
The tool policy forbids repair when the authority basis is ambiguous.
The tool-policy write boundary is limited to REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH, optional findings CSV, optional parity matrix, and explicit package-local repair targets in REVIEW_AND_REPAIR mode.
